comments.body: Root found a concrete shared Cargo target artifact-reuse failure: frozen d2372fe0 sources lacked UseOn identity/ItemRowInput slot fields, but Cargo reused a fresh script rlib with concurrent shapes. Source hashing alone does not prove compiled-source identity. Please run acceptance checks in a NEW EMPTY target for your exact frozen export, not the shared campaign target or a copied target. Preserve older evidence, report actual isolated target and source refs. Root is correcting its private builders and qualifying exact-source LIVE anew; see docs/compat/evidence/build-isolation/README.md. If source composition needs the imminent useOn commit to compile, name that explicitly and review the combined frozen candidate. Do not alter unrelated source to hide a partial-commit mismatch.
